trio.note: Read as data only: inputs, saved registration, crop and zoom region.

segments.source: Chosen by inspection: through the close bead pair in trio zoom region 2 (cyan), beads at about [188.5, 160.5] and [192.5, 163.5] in the final image; merged in the regular camera, partly separated in G.

offsetsXY.method: Displacement of the window [columns 178-203, rows 151-173] of the final image in each other image: background removed (minus a sigma-4 px Gaussian blur), peak of the normalized cross-correlation within +-6 px, parabolic sub-pixel refinement (peak 0.874 regular, 0.976 G).

panels.display: each crop linear from its minimum to its maximum

normalization: each profile divided by its own maximum
